what: A round character badge floats at bottom right. Hover or press it and one of the speech bubbles hidden on the left (a one-line recommended article) pops up at random and disappears after 4 seconds. Hover again and a different bubble swaps in and the 4 seconds restart — a magazine corner badge where the mascot calls out ”look at this”

options.hold: Duration the speech bubble stays (ms), default 4000
options.order: If 1, runs in order instead of randomly (for demos and QA)
options.--fx-dur: Off-transition duration (CSS variable), default .3s — the original changes display, so it actually turns on and off instantly
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Speech bubbles (multiple) — is-on when turned on. Tail and border are set in the using side’s css

use:
One line of text

Other words
note: The original is random each time, so the speech bubble shown differs on every open

from.where: shared.js bottom-right character badge (.gh-badge — 75px circle, four speech bubbles, white panel · 1px border · tail SVG)
